title: Miraj Samarakkody
text:
I’m an Assistant Professor of Mathematics at Tougaloo College. I trained as a differential geometer at Texas Tech University, studying variational problems for curves and surfaces, and I now work where geometry meets computation. My current work uses physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) to compute geometric quantities and Lean 4 to formally verify classical theorems.

title: Research
text:
🔬 Research Interests
I am a mathematician specializing in differential geometry. My current research interests are Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs), manifold learning, and formal proof verification using Lean 4.


💻 Open-Source Projects
My open-source projects are available on my GitHub page.
The chart below shows my public GitHub contribution history, reflecting ongoing development across my open-source projects in formal verification, symbolic computation, and differential geometry.
